profile.visual_desc: Large human in bulky blue plate armor with oversized pauldrons. Features a horned helmet and a long red tabard hanging between the legs.
profile.face_cutin_desc: A blue armored knight helmet with a dark T-shaped visor and a single glowing red horizontal eye slit. Expressionless and imposing.
profile.weapon_desc: Massive blue conical lance held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Standing in a front-isometric view facing down-right. The lance is held diagonally across the body, pointing toward the ground.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight back and raises the heavy lance to chest height, preparing for a forward thrusting motion.
profile.step3_impact: Lunges forward with the lance. A sharp burst of yellow and white jagged energy spikes radiates from the tip toward the bottom-right.
profile.step4_finish: Pulls the weapon back to a neutral stance as the yellow energy sparks quickly fade and disappear.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The yellow energy burst in Frame 4 must originate exactly from the lance tip and extend along the vector of the forward thrust.

evaluation.diagnosis: Sequence accurately reproduces thrust mechanics and VFX timing.
